column1: # Differences of the value grids (tools/decomp_oracle.py report --grid-label) that are not errors. Tab-separated:
# class: impossible (no caller can produce the state; the reason says how that is known) or the id of an anomaly.
# registers: what may differ, comma-separated: <register> or <register>:<mask>, the mask being the bits that may differ
# (hexadecimal). writes: none, the only value read: a line never allows a byte written.
# A difference is sorted only if its label matches AND all it touches is allowed: another register, a bit outside the
# mask, a byte, a call, or a record that lists nothing stays a real difference, printed as DIFFERENCE.

column6: A NaN only a double can hold, in an argument that enters an fmadds directly: gc_float.h returns a single and drops the low 29 bits, DolRecomp keeps the double. The three direct calls load f3, f5 and f6 with lfs, which only gives single NaNs.
